show.name: WOW - Women of Wrestling
show.summary: The series will feature 35 wrestlers, including third generation wrestling superstar Tessa Blanchard, returning superheroes The Beast, Stephy Slays, Jungle Grrrl, Beverly Hills Babe and talented newcomers to WOW such as Faith the Lioness and Princess Aussie.

episodes.name: The Hunter Has Become the Hunted!
Picking Sides: Where is Your Loyalty?
Never Take a Loss Lying Down
Leaving It All in the Ring
Light at the End of the Tunnel
Why, Vickie? Why?
episodes.summary: Vickie Lynn McCoy finally breaks her silence about her actions against The Beast before the two women meet in the ring, while the Mother Truckers: Big Rig Betty and Holly Swag get another chance for comeuppance against Las Bandidas: Sylvia Sanchez and Vivian Rivera in an epic No-Disqualification Tag Team Match. The Last Call Reina Del Rey and Wrecking Ball set their sights on The Tag Team Championships, using their match against Spring Break 24/7 to make a point about what type of values they want to represent in WOW. Also in action, Gloria Glitter and Keta Rush!

Instinct for Victory
episodes.summary: The WOW Battle Royal for the World Championship approaches as the Superheroes continue to vie to qualify, including Genesis, who faces new Superhero Ashley Blaze.
